name: Earthbending Mastery
text: {X}{G}{G}: Untap target land, then earthbend X. (Target land you control becomes a 0/0 creature with haste that's still a land. Put X +1/+1 counters on it. When it dies or is exiled, return it to the battlefield tapped.)

name: Fear of Technology
text:
Players can't cast artifacts and enchantments spells.
Activated abilities of artifacts and enchantments can't be activated.
ChatGPT can't be used.
flavorText: It saw your browsing history. It didn't like the fact you even have a phone.

name: Hearthstone Rules
text: Creatures can attack other creatures. (You figure it out)

name: I Don't Know Anymore
text: Search your library for a custom creature card and a noncustom creature card. If you do, put them onto the battlefield combined into one creature. (Its power is equal to their total power, its toughness is equal to their total toughness, and it has their names, mana costs, types, text boxes, etc.)

name: MrBeast Within
text: Destroy target permanent. Its controller creates a MrBeast token.
flavorText:
"Monsters dwell in every heart… but this is just fucked up."
—Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Mwonvuli Awakened
text:
({T}: Add {G}.)
Trample, vigilance
Mwonvuli's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creatures you control plus the number of lands you control.
Whenever Mwonvuli deals combat damage to a player, create that many 1/1 green Forest Dryad land creature tokens. (They're affected by summoning sickness.)

name: Nature's Consumption
text: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. Create X 1/1 black and green Pest creature tokens with "When this token dies, you gain 1 life", where X is that permanent's mana value.
flavorText: Witherbloom students delight in wagering over which pest will bloat into the fattest first.

name: Overwhelming Crush-Out
text: Vehicles you control become artifact creatures until end of turn. Creatures you control get +3/+3 and gain trample until end of turn.
flavorText: Gonti's secret backup plan, in case Aetherdrift wouldn't sell well.

name: Resonance
text:
Resonance for permanents (This spell costs {X} less to cast, where X is the total mana value of permanents you control.)
Draw X cards.
flavorText: "Life, when lived to the fullest, teaches us that within each of us, there's the beauty of all of us."

name: Their Legacy Remembered
text: Exile target player's graveyard. You gain 1 life for each card exiled this way, then learn for each three cards exiled this way. (You may reveal a Lesson card you own from outside the game and put it into your hand, or discard a card to draw a card.)
